question: Which of the following is a tough, porous and black substance, and almost a pure form of carbon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coke**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coke is a tough, porous, and black substance that is almost a pure form of carbon.**
 
• It is obtained by heating coal in the** absence of air to remove volatile compounds, leaving behind a carbon-rich solid.**
 
• **Coke **is commonly used as a **fuel in industries like steelmaking, where it is used as a reducing agent to remove impurities from iron ore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bitumen**

 
 
• **​**It is also known as **asphalt is a black, sticky, and highly viscous liquid or semi-solid form of petroleum.**
 
• It is commonly used in the construction industry for** road surfacing, roofing, and waterproofing.**
 
• **Bitumen contains carbon, but it is not a pure form of carbon.**
 
 
 
• **Coal tar**
 
 
• **​**It is a black, **viscous liquid **that is produced during the distillation of coal.
 
• **It contains a variety of organic compounds, including polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs).**
 
• Coal tar has been used in the past for medicinal purposes and as a component in the production of dyes, but it is also a known human carcinogen.
 
 
 
• **Coal gas:**
 
 
• It is also known as town gas is **a flammable gas that is produced by heating coal in the presence of air or steam.**
 
• **It is primarily composed of hydrogen, methane, and carbon monoxide, with small amounts of other gases.**
 
• While coal gas does contain carbon, **it is not a tough, porous, or black substance.**
